purpose: Teach: こみ/削る/利く/扱える/照らさ/考え直し/挙がっ/緩め

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 駅のラッシュ、人こみ、避けて移動しろ。
lines.en: Avoid the station crowds when moving around.
lines.style: Clipped, direct. Gives the instruction without preamble. Calm authority. Eye-contact level. No waste.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経費、無駄な項目、削るよう、見直しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've reviewed the expenses and trimmed the wasteful items.
lines.style: Steady, methodical delivery. Each phrase lands clearly. Slight pause between items to show work done. Respectful attention — looking at or near Hiroshi.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 彼の交渉力、よく利くな。
lines.en: His negotiation skills are working well.
lines.style: Observant, almost to himself. Light appreciation in the tone. Not quite praise — more accurate assessment. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。多言語が扱える社員、貴重です。
lines.en: Yes. Multi-lingual staff members are quite valuable.
lines.style: Agreement without embellishment. Warm undertone — genuine, not flattering. Brief, letting the observation stand on its own merit.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 資料、ライトで照らさないと、読めないな。
lines.en: I can't read the materials without proper lighting.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation. Slight frustration — not at Kenji, at the situation. Practical problem-solving tone. Pause before the conclusion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。決定、もう一度、考え直しましょうか。
lines.en: Yes. Should we reconsider the decision once more?
lines.style: Checking in rather than assuming. Gentle offer of revision. Soft on the question mark — inviting input, not demanding. Respectful pause.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 問題、また挙がってきたか?
lines.en: Are we running into problems again?
lines.style: Calm inquiry. No irritation — pattern recognition. Slight sigh underneath. Expects an answer. Direct but not sharp.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。締め切り、緩めに設定し直します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll reset the deadlines with more flexibility.
lines.style: Decisive commitment. Shows he's heard and is moving to action. Quiet confidence. Slight lift at the end — readiness to proceed.
